message.content:
**altavista.com** refers to **AltaVista**, the once-popular web search engine that launched in December 1995 and is now **defunct**. The original domain was eventually redirected to Yahoo Search, and the service was shut down in July 2013.[1]

If you meant the current website at that domain, there is no active AltaVista search engine there today.[1]

answer_text:
**altavista.com** refers to **AltaVista**, the once-popular web search engine that launched in December 1995 and is now **defunct**. The original domain was eventually redirected to Yahoo Search, and the service was shut down in July 2013.[1]

If you meant the current website at that domain, there is no active AltaVista search engine there today.[1]
